gpu-graph.local-clustering-directed-closurescurated\term{coefficient}{C}_v=\frac{\term{closures}{T}_v}{\term{degree}{d}_v\,(\term{degree}{d}_v-1)}\ (d_v\ge2,\ \text{else }0),\quad T_v=\sum_{a<b\in N(v)}\big(\term{forwardClosure}{[a\to b]}+\term{reverseClosure}{[b\to a]}\big)Direct kernel (chosen for this sparse graph): degree counts distinct weak neighbors; closureCount sums, over every unordered neighbor pair a < b, forwardClosure (a->b exists) + reverseClosure (b->a exists); output = closureCount / (degree * (degree - 1)) when degree >= 2 else 0. On undirected CSR each triangle contributes two closures, so this equals 2T / (d(d-1)). Overflow publishes zero.
